observations: The upper body remains one continuous Polygon2D texture while native Bone2D weights move the sleeves.
Leather, metal and collar protection keeps the belt and buttons attached to the torso.
Editor Bone2D gizmos were excluded from SubViewport artwork; neutral source-region comparison is identical for all eight directions.
remaining_art_work: Sharp sleeve bends can produce pointed or crowded silhouette pixels and require native weight/UV correction.
The pelvis is a separate authored asset; final waist occlusion and lower-body assembly remain separate from this upper-body workshop.
